cases.name: Lorraine E. Patterson
cases.about:
Her obituary said, "In knowing Mrs. Patterson, you knew she was all about faith, family and friends. If you did not know her, once you spoke with her you fell in love. Mrs. Patterson feed her faith by attending the Olivet UMC; she was an excellent seamstress and a fabulous baker."

https://www.adamsfuneralhome.org/obituaries/Lorraine-Patterson/#!/Obituary
cases.narrative: He attacked her on her 95th birthday on Jan. 29, 2015. Patterson suffered head trauma, facial fractures, a brain bleed and a broken jaw when Rose hit her with the padlock inside a sock after she tried to intervene in her grandson’s attack on his father, Marc Rose.
